options.html: \begin{aligned}\pi \int_{\sqrt{3}/2}^{1} \Bigl( 1 + \sqrt{1 + y^2} \Bigr)^2 dy - \pi \int_{0}^{\sqrt{3}/2} 3 y^2 dy + \pi \int_{0}^{1} \Bigl( 1 - \sqrt{1 - y^2} \Bigr)^2 dy\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}\pi \int_{\sqrt{3}/2}^{1} \left( 1 + \sqrt{1+y^2} \right)^2 dy + \pi \int_{0}^{\sqrt{3}/2} 3y^2 dy + \pi \int_{0}^{1} \left( 1 - \sqrt{1-y^2} \right)^2 dy\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}\pi \int_{\sqrt{3}/2}^{1} \biggl( 1 + \sqrt{1 + y^2} \biggr)^2 dy + \pi \int_{0}^{\sqrt{3}/2} 3 y^2 dy - \pi \int_{0}^{1} \biggl( 1 - \sqrt{1 - y^2} \biggr)^2 dy\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{两曲线在第一象限的交点为}\left(\frac{3}{2},\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right),\text{以}y\text{为积分变量，则积分区间为}\left[0,1\right],\text{所以立体的体积为}\pi\int_{\sqrt{3}/2}^{1}\left(1+\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\right)^{2}dy+\pi\int_{0}^{\sqrt{3}/2}3y^{2}dy-\pi\int_{0}^{1}\left(1-\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\right)^{2}dy \end{aligned}
